title: Walking a tree
hints: filepath.WalkDir(root, fn) calls fn for root and for everything below it. If fn returns filepath.SkipDir for a directory, WalkDir doesn't go inside it.
Return err straight away when the callback receives one. For files, d.Info() gives you the size.
Skip a directory when d.IsDir() && path != root && strings.HasPrefix(d.Name(), "."). Comparing with root keeps a walk of "." from skipping everything.
